text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. speaker: Doctor
text: Does the pain feel sharp and colicky, coming in waves, or is it a constant dull ache? Have you experienced any fever, chills, or unusual vaginal discharge?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain and cramping. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Pain with urination, Burning pain during intercourse.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a fever or any unusual vaginal discharge, and is the abdominal pain constant or does it come in waves? I would also like to request a pelvic exam and urine analysis to check for infection or other abnormalities. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal urinalysis, I suspect a gynecological issue like PID or an ovarian cyst rather than a UTI. Can you describe any vaginal discharge or bleeding, and does the pain worsen with movement or deep breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Menarche at 13 years, regular menses every 28 days, lasting for 5 days. No significant past medical or surgical history. Social history: Currently in a relationship with one male partner. Reports inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you miss your last period, and have you noticed any abnormal vaginal bleeding or discharge? I need to rule out pregnancy-related complications or pelvic inflammatory disease given your sexual history. REQUEST TEST: Urine_Pregnancy_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: With a negative pregnancy test and normal urinalysis, I need to evaluate for gynecological causes like PID or ovarian pathology. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: I see the ultrasound results were not provided; could you please clarify if there are any adnexal masses or free fluid noted on the imaging? Also, on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is your pain right now, and do you have any shoulder tip pain? REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the ultrasound results are unavailable, I must rely on your clinical symptoms and sexual history. Do you have a fever, and have you noticed any unusual vaginal discharge or bleeding?
